about: The reference rule for one cell's replacement (ADR-0332 §2): every occurrence of the text in the entry, compared as Find compares; with Whole cell, the entry whole; nothing where the entry does not match. From dotnet/tests/ExGrid.Tests/GridReplaceTests.cs.
subject: GridReplace

cases.name: ADR-0332 §2: every occurrence in the entry is replaced, compared OrdinalIgnoreCase
ADR-0332 §2 / ADR-0023: with Match case, only the occurrences of that case
ADR-0332 §2: with Whole cell, an equal entry is replaced whole and any other is no match
ADR-0332 §2: an entry that does not match has no replacement
ADR-0332 §2 / ADR-0055: an empty pattern matches nothing
ADR-0332 §2: an empty replacement removes the text
ADR-0332 §2: the rest of the entry keeps its case
ADR-0332 §2: occurrences are taken left to right and never overlap, and a replacement is never searched again
ADR-0332 §2: a replacement is written as it is, a dollar sign included
